title: On stationary actions of locally compact groups and their Radon-Nikodym cocycles
summary: We study stationary actions of locally compact measured groups through the structure and regularity of their Radon-Nikodym cocycles. We start with two dynamical consequences of stationarity. Extending a theorem of Furstenberg-Glasner from discrete groups to noncompact locally compact groups, we show that every stationary action is conservative. Thus stationary actions are never of type I. We then show that an ergodic stationary action admitting an absolutely continuous invariant sigma-finite measure is in fact probability preserving.
